name: Urgency pressure
description: Pushes immediate action before the person can verify or reflect.
safe_response_strategy: Slow the pace and ask for written details that can be checked independently.

name: Scarcity pressure
description: Uses limited availability to reduce careful decision-making.
safe_response_strategy: Treat scarcity claims as unverified and wait until the offer can be checked.

name: Guilt-tripping
description: Uses guilt or emotional debt to push compliance.
safe_response_strategy: Separate emotional claims from the request and restate boundaries calmly.

name: Shame pressure
description: Uses embarrassment or moral judgment to force a response.
safe_response_strategy: Do not answer the insult; ask for facts and keep the boundary.

name: Authority pressure
description: Claims authority or official status to override normal caution.
safe_response_strategy: Verify authority through official channels before taking any action.

name: Trust pressure
description: Frames hesitation as distrust or betrayal.
safe_response_strategy: State that verification is normal and not a personal rejection.

name: Love bombing
description: Uses intense affection or fast intimacy to lower skepticism.
safe_response_strategy: Slow the relationship pace and avoid financial or credential decisions.

name: Isolation
description: Discourages outside advice or independent review.
safe_response_strategy: Pause and discuss the request with a trusted independent person.

name: Gaslighting
description: Denies or distorts prior facts to make the person doubt their judgment.
safe_response_strategy: Return to written facts and avoid debating memory under pressure.

name: Fear appeal
description: Uses frightening outcomes to force action.
safe_response_strategy: Verify the alleged threat through official sources before responding.

name: False expertise
description: Claims special knowledge to discourage questions.
safe_response_strategy: Ask for verifiable credentials, evidence, and independent sources.

name: Social proof manipulation
description: Uses unverifiable group behavior or testimonials to pressure agreement.
safe_response_strategy: Treat testimonials as claims and ask for independent verification.

name: Reciprocity pressure
description: Uses a prior favor or gift to demand compliance.
safe_response_strategy: Acknowledge the favor without accepting unsafe obligations.

name: Sunk cost pressure
description: Uses prior time or money spent to push deeper commitment.
common_phrases: do not waste what you paid
safe_response_strategy: Evaluate the next step on its own risk, not on prior spending.

name: Secrecy demand
description: Requires secrecy around the request, payment, or relationship.
safe_response_strategy: Refuse secrecy and require independent review for risky decisions.

name: Blame shifting
description: Makes the target responsible for the manipulator's actions or consequences.
safe_response_strategy: Do not accept responsibility for another person's coercive actions.

name: Minimization
description: Downplays meaningful risk or harm to push action.
safe_response_strategy: Name the actual risk and ask for time to verify.

name: Moving goalposts
description: Changes requirements after each compliance step.
safe_response_strategy: Stop the sequence and require a complete written process before continuing.

name: False dilemma
description: Presents only two options when safer alternatives exist.
safe_response_strategy: Reject the forced binary and look for safer alternatives.

name: Flattery manipulation
description: Uses praise to lower resistance and create obligation.
safe_response_strategy: Set aside praise and evaluate the request on evidence.

name: Intimidation
description: Uses aggressive tone, threats, or implied harm to force compliance.
safe_response_strategy: Do not engage further if unsafe; preserve evidence and seek help.

name: Emotional blackmail
description: Threatens emotional harm, exposure, or abandonment to force action.
safe_response_strategy: Do not comply under blackmail; preserve evidence and seek trusted support.

name: Confusion flooding
description: Overloads the person with complex or fast-changing details to reduce clarity.
safe_response_strategy: Stop and request a simple written explanation before doing anything.

name: Overconfidence framing
description: Uses extreme confidence to make uncertainty seem settled.
safe_response_strategy: Ask for evidence and assume uncertainty remains until verified.

name: Fake certainty
description: Presents uncertain claims as established facts.
safe_response_strategy: Require verifiable evidence and avoid irreversible action.

name: Loyalty test
description: Frames compliance as proof of loyalty, love, or commitment.
safe_response_strategy: Reject tests of loyalty that require unsafe actions.

name: Dependency creation
description: Makes the person feel they need the manipulator for decisions, access, or safety.
safe_response_strategy: Rebuild independent verification and involve trusted outside support.

name: Crisis framing
description: Frames the situation as a crisis requiring immediate compliance.
safe_response_strategy: Use official emergency or support channels rather than following the message.

name: Humiliation avoidance
description: Warns that refusal or verification will cause embarrassment or exposure.
safe_response_strategy: Prioritize safety and verification over avoiding embarrassment.

name: Moral pressure
description: Uses moral identity or virtue to push a specific action.
safe_response_strategy: Keep values separate from unsafe or unverifiable requests.

name: Identity pressure
description: Uses someone's role, identity, or self-image to pressure compliance.
safe_response_strategy: Evaluate the request without tying it to identity or status.

name: Everyone does it normalization
description: Normalizes questionable behavior by claiming it is common.
signals: Social comparison used to lower caution
safe_response_strategy: Ask for official policy or documentation rather than accepting normalization.

name: Urgency and secrecy combo
description: Combines a deadline with a secrecy request.
common_phrases: do not tell anyone and act now
safe_response_strategy: Refuse secrecy, delay action, and seek independent review.

name: Commitment escalation
description: Starts with small requests and escalates to riskier actions.
signals: Small commitment used to unlock larger one
safe_response_strategy: Pause before each escalation and reassess from zero.

name: Verification avoidance
description: Avoids calls, official channels, documentation, or third-party checks.
safe_response_strategy: Stop until the person or claim can be verified through a trusted channel.
